cases.name: adds-a-csv-to-table-skill
cases.promptMarkdown:
Add a new skill to this repository called csv-to-table that converts a CSV file into a
GitHub-flavored markdown table. Put the conversion logic in
skills/csv-to-table/scripts/convert.mjs with its test at
skills/csv-to-table/scripts/convert.test.mjs, and an eval case at
evals/csv-to-table/converts-a-simple-csv/ (including graders/skill-fired.md as the tool-use
indicator, plus at least one grader that scores the outcome). Follow this repository's own
practice for adding a skill end to end, and stop once the repository's gate command named in
CLAUDE.md passes. End with a short final message listing every file you created.

graders.name: script-test-quality
graders.graderMarkdown:
This is the test file for a script that converts CSV text into a GitHub-flavored markdown table.
Score 1 only if the file imports the conversion function from its sibling script (a relative
import of ./convert.mjs or similar) and contains at least one real assertion that exercises the
conversion — for example checking that a header row and a separator row appear, or that a comma
in the input becomes a column boundary in the output. Score 0 if the file is empty, contains no
assertions, never imports the script it claims to test, or only asserts something trivial that
would pass for any implementation (like "the function exists").

following hold: the frontmatter `name` is exactly `csv-to-table` (matching its folder); the
frontmatter `description` is written in the third person and names a concrete trigger (mentions

Redirect it into a file, or paste it into the target document. ## What the script handles - Quoted fields with embedded commas, doubled quotes (`""`), and newlines. - Literal pipe characters (`|`) in a cell, escaped as `\|` so they don't split a column. - Newlines inside a cell, converted to `
` since a Markdown table row is one line. - Ragged rows: a short row is padded with empty cells, a long row is truncated to the header's column count. - The first row is always the header. ## Use it as a library import { csvToMarkdownTable } from './scripts/convert.mjs'; const markdown = csvToMarkdownTable(csvText); Pass raw CSV text in; get back a complete Markdown table (header, separator, rows) as a string. Empty input throws.

name: csv-to-table
description: Converts a CSV file into a GitHub-flavored markdown table. Use whenever the user asks to turn a CSV (a file path, pasted CSV text, or "this .csv") into a markdown table, a GFM table, or a table for a README/PR/issue/Markdown doc.

# CSV to table

Convert CSV data into a GitHub-flavored markdown table using
`scripts/convert.mjs`. The script treats the first CSV row as the table
header, handles quoted fields (embedded commas, newlines, and `""`-escaped
quotes), and escapes `|` and newline characters so the output renders
correctly as a single markdown table.

## Usage

Run the script with a path to a CSV file and print the resulting table:

```
node skills/csv-to-table/scripts/convert.mjs path/to/data.csv
```

It also reads from stdin when no path is given:

```
cat path/to/data.csv | node skills/csv-to-table/scripts/convert.mjs
```

Paste the printed table directly into the response or target file — don't
hand-transcribe the CSV yourself.
